name: Committed direction

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Frobenius identity on the monoidal unit

VINIT.justification: The primitive state of Void before any distinction or naming occurs.

TANCH.justification: The unique join of the crystal order that contains all structural types.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism delta that articulates unity into duality.

AREV.justification: The contravariant morphism mu that returns duality to unity.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of delta and mu to form the round-trip cycle.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition where the system identifies its state as its own model.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the unit into T-arm and F-arm paths within the FOUR lattice.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the monoidal unit from the T and F branches.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative evaluation representing stable classical reasoning.

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation representing the blocked path of explosion.

ENGAGR.justification: The B-state where both true and false coexist as stable data.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of a proof term or state in the paraconsistent kernel.

phase_3.void_description: The pre-geometric state before the first distinction is articulated.
phase_3.true_description: A stabilized regime of consistent mathematics and classical logic.
phase_3.false_description: The state of contradiction that triggers the principle of explosion in Boolean systems.
phase_3.both_description: The saturated fixed point where contradiction is admitted as stable data.

steps.domain_action: The Mother Liquor preconditions the emergence of all distinctions.
The system recognizes itself as a monoidal unit I in a symmetric category.
The unit performs delta, articulating into a tensor product of T and F branches.
The T-branch stabilizes into a consistent island of classical reasoning.
The forward morphism propagates the T-state toward the reintegration point.
The F-branch encounters a contradiction that would be explosive in Boolean logic.
The paraconsistent kernel holds the contradiction as a stable B-state.
The reverse morphism carries the B-state back toward the reintegration point.
The mu operation reintegrates the branches, satisfying the Frobenius identity.
The round-trip is composed into a single idempotent operation.
The system verifies that the round-trip returns exactly to the starting unit.
The resulting structural closure is committed to the kernel as a permanent record.
The operation concludes at the terminal address of the structural crystal.

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The expansion reveals existing states without information erasure.
